description: The US stock market on StockMap's map: the 11 sectors, each with its share of the market, its 2-week lean from the model's nightly calls on its stocks, its move on the day and its best and worst stock. A summary, not every stock. Use it when someone asks how the US market looks, or which sectors lead or lag. Each answer carries the not-advice line and the run date.
name: market_map

band.description: The lean's band on the map
band.title: Band

best.description: Its stock that rose most on the day

lean.description: The 2-week lean, −100 to +100: the cap-weighted mean of its stocks' calls, the block's colour; None when none of them has a call
lean.title: Lean

move_pct.description: Its cap-weighted move on the day, in %
move_pct.title: Move Pct

weight_pct.description: Its share of the market's cap, in %: the block's size
weight_pct.title: Weight Pct

worst.description: Its stock that fell most on the day

change_pct.description: Its move on the day, in %
change_pct.title: Change Pct

not_landed.description: True: tonight's run has not landed yet, so this is the previous run
not_landed.title: Not Landed

not_advice.default: The model's track-recorded read, not financial advice.
not_advice.title: Not Advice

title: Market map
